parse.title: Lumbridge & Draynor Diary
parse.wikitext:
===Rewards===
*[[Explorer's ring 4]]:
**Can restore full [[Energy|run energy]] three times a day
**Allows 30 casts of [[High Level Alchemy]] without [[runes]] each day (no experience granted unless done at the [[Alchemist's Playground]], still requires 55 [[Magic]])
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*20% discount on items in the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]]
*Steal twice as many [[cave goblin wire]]s in [[Dorgesh-Kaan]]
*Ability to use [[fairy rings]] without the need of a [[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]]
*Unlocks the seventh slot for blocking [[Slayer task|Slayer tasks]]
